benchmark_provenance.selection: Existing test split only, in benchmark order; no re-embedding or parameter selection

benchmark_validation.validation_scope: Exact parsed source spans/full rows, claim links, source identity, and company-disjoint splits; not semantic answer accuracy or exhaustive relevance.
benchmark_validation.coverage_counting: Year/company counts include each distinct source year/company once per question; comparative questions can contribute to several companies.
benchmark_validation.memory_policy: Stream each source document; retain only gold-selected element/table fields, then release them.

comparison.ann_recall_definition: Mean per-query intersection of index and exact Flat top-k vector-ID sets divided by min(k, vector count); this is not gold document or evidence Recall@k

build.build_time_scope: FAISS index.train plus index.add; excludes embedding, validation, mapping, serialization, and hashes
build.pipeline_time_scope: build_faiss_index call including input validation, metadata mapping, train/add, serialization, and hashes; excludes embedding and preflight input checksum verification

query.memory_scope: Current process resident working-set/RSS increase from FAISS-imported, query-loaded baseline to index loaded; warmed delta is recorded separately; excludes embedding model, corpus input vectors, and chunk payloads
query.memory_units: decimal MB = 1,000,000 bytes; process RSS is operating-system dependent, not a native allocation counter or peak build memory
query.isolation_requirement: Run each index query worker in a new Python process; do not compare same-process loads
query.latency_scope: CPU index.search only, one query at a time at latency_k; excludes embedding, loading, validation, warmup, sorting, payload resolution, and gold scoring
query.reference_search_policy: Independent single-query search for each requested k with identical FAISS thread count; no batch-query reference or top-50-prefix substitution
query.tie_policy: Equal-score returned candidates sorted by vector ID; exact boundary candidate set remains FAISS-selected; strict ANN ID recall can penalize equivalent boundary ties

gold_evidence.search_policy: Native single-query index.search independently at each k, ties sorted by vector ID; no metadata filters
